dossier_meta.statement_text: There is an absolute constant $C>0$ such that $r(F,K_{n}^{(3)})\leq 2^{O_{F}(n^{C})}$ for every fixed linear $3$-graph $F$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Following Theorem 1.4, which disproves the polynomial upper bound for linear $3$-graphs, the authors propose the weaker conjecture that $r(F,K_{n}^{(3)})$ remains subexponential for linear $F$. They note possible further strengthenings (replacing $n^C$ by $n^{o(1)}$ or extending to $123$-inducible $3$-graphs) but are less certain about those variants.
